Protect Your Financial Security – Cynthia Nutter Interview

Download our FREE Leadership Development Plan Workbook here: http://bit.ly/eglworkbook2

Cynthia Nutter from CJ Nutter Accounting Services joins us to talk about how to protect your financial security. We talk about how she uses effective leadership and management skills to help her clients make good financial decisions.  We also discuss the management skills she uses to run CJ Nutter Accounting Services. Jason LeDuc of Evil Genius Leadership Consultants hosts the Geeks R Sexy show every 4th Thursday of the month to bring you great conversations with successful business leaders and keeps you up to date on all the latest Las Vegas business news.

You should watch this video if you want to:

- See how Cynthia Nutter can help you protect your financial security using effective leadership and management skills
- Learn how she uses her management skills to run CJ Nutter Accounting Services
- Keep up with Las Vegas business news and everything going on with Evil Genius Leadership Consultants and Geeks R Sexy
